centreline_definitions_mm.method: Derived from the midpoints of visibly associated A11/as-2 blue outer-member traces, calibrated independently against the C-D-E 4850/4850/9700 dimension chain and +0/+4500 levels. The drawing traces determine member axis length; text location is not used as geometry.
centreline_definitions_mm.section_orientation: A11/as-2 is a YZ elevation at the exact local axis-2 station X=61050 mm. The three vertical HEA180 source contour pairs show nominal flange width b=180 mm in the elevation plane, so section height h=171 mm is placed out of plane along X. The horizontal HEA160 source contour shows section height h=152 mm in the elevation plane and flange width b=160 mm out of plane along X.
